identity.title: A Submillimeter Burst of S255IR SMA1: The Rise and Fall of Its Luminosity

paper_type_evidence.quote: We report in this Letter the rise and fall of the 900 ${\mu}$m continuum emission and the newly found 349.1 GHz methanol maser emission in the massive star forming region S255IR SMA1

evidence.quote: S255IR is a massive cluster formation region with a bolometric luminosity of several 10$^{4}$ L$_\odot$ at a distance of 1.78$^{+0.12}_{-0.11}$ kpc (cite: Burns16).
